meta.title: Withdrawing Order...: A very long reason is handled consistently

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ without recreating or searching for another event.
Open the RFQ stage referenced by the case.
Reach the Responses tab before opening the stage Settings menu.
Open the RFQ stage withdrawal dialog.

args.goal: In the withdrawal dialog, enter exactly 5,000 consecutive uppercase A characters in the reason field labeled "Please enter reason for withdrawing this event", verify what remains in the field, click "Yes", and record any validation message or submission result shown.

steps.note: Perform and observe the exact long-reason interaction that no fixed-value assertion can conveniently encode.
Assert that the RFQ stage was withdrawn after submitting the long reason.
